contents: release and its four time constants
the validation status of 192 rules and the 18 known defects

defect19.bug: `接收人：尚未指定` passed — the rule looked for the label `接收人：` and never for a name, so a handover stating plainly that nobody had taken over was accepted
defect19.foundBy: writing this project's own handover honestly
defect19.fix: the receiver slot rejects non-answers: 尚未…, 未指定, 待定, 待指派, 暂无, 没有, 无, TBD, N/A, none, a bare dash
defect19.selfCaught: the new rule's own regex was wrong first (anchored alternation of 尚未 never matched 尚未指定); its firing test caught it before the release

gate.assertion: the project's handover may produce exactly one error, receiver-unassigned; a second error is a defect in the document or the check
